CustomField.description: Master switch for the second-model verification gate. Default true: after a draft passes the score floor and grounding, one cheap model call (Draft_Verify_Model__c) must confirm the draft answers the customer's specific question using only claims supported by the cited sources. Fail closed - any non-approval, uncertainty, parse error, or callout failure declines with NO_DRAFT_UNVERIFIED. Turn OFF to disable the gate without a code deploy (e.g. if the Einstein Requests budget is not approved).
CustomField.label: Draft Verify Enabled
